items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: And then they used to have Boca, Boca started coming around there too with them.

ctx.x: What do you mean ambitious? What do you mean Earl was ambitious?

Well he's always fooling with the music, you know, always interested, man. You know. Huey and all of them, you know. Yeah. Yeah. And then they used to have Boca, Boca started coming around there too with them.
